title: Email
summary: Read, draft, send, organize, and clean up email.

resources.reason: The connected JMAP provider owns account lifecycle; Agent Slayer exposes its authoritative read only.
The connected JMAP provider owns mailbox lifecycle; this adapter currently exposes mailbox reads and message membership changes.
The connected JMAP provider owns sending-identity lifecycle; Agent Slayer exposes its authoritative read only.
Live JMAP tools expose provider-owned draft creation, reads, updates, recovery, and destruction under the provider contract rather than native database CRUD.
JMAP threads are provider-derived message groupings and have no independent native mutation lifecycle.
JMAP blobs are immutable provider-owned message or attachment payloads read through their owning message identity.
